metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from January 27, 2017 to February 2, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about whether Lake Menindee in Australia shrank between January 27, 2017 and February 2, 2019. This requires: 1. **Strategy**: Compare water surface area at two time points 2. **Data**: Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for water detection 3. **Location**: Lake Menindee, Australia 4. **Dates**: - Start: January 27, 2017 - End: February 2, 2019 5. **Processing**: - Cloud masking - Water detection (NDWI or classification) - Calculate water area for both dates - Compare areas I'll use Sentinel-2 MSI data with cloud masking and NDWI for water detection. Need to handle: - Check if collections have data - Count valid pixels after masking - Calculate water area - Validate results For water detection, I'll use NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) with threshold > 0 to identify water pixels. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Point([142.4, -32.3]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around Lake Menindee const date1 = '2017-01-27'; const date2 = '2019-02-02'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getWaterImage(date) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'month')); if (col.size().getInfo() === 0) { return null; } // Cloud masking function function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const maskedCol = col.map(maskS2clouds); const composite = maskedCol.median(); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask (NDWI > 0) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); return waterMask; } // Get images for both dates const water2017 = getWaterImage(date1); const water2019 = getWaterImage(date2); // Check for empty collections if (!water2017 || !water2019) { console.log("2017 Images: " + (water2017 ? "Available" : "None")); console.log("2019 Images: " + (water2019 ? "Available" : "None")); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate water areas function calculateWaterArea(waterMask) { const areaImage = waterMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); // Area in m² const stats = areaImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area = stats.get('NDWI'); const pixelCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); return {area: area, pixelCount: pixelCount}; } const area2017 = calculateWaterArea(water2017); const area2019 = calculateWaterArea(water2019); const area2017Val = area2017.area.getInfo(); const area2019Val = area2019.area.getInfo(); const pixels2017 = area2017.pixelCount.getInfo(); const pixels2019 = area2019.pixelCount.getInfo(); // Check for no valid pixels if (pixels2017 === 0 || pixels2019 === 0) { console.log(`2017 Pixels: ${pixels2017}, 2019 Pixels: ${pixels2019}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (area2017Val === null || area2019Val === null || isNaN(area2017Val) || isNaN(area2019Val) || area2017Val < 0 || area2019Val < 0) { console.log(`2017 Area: ${area2017Val}, 2019 Area: ${area2019Val}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Determine if lake shrank const area2017Km2 = area2017Val / 1000000; // Convert to km² const area2019Km2 = area2019Val / 1000000; const shrinkage = ((area2017Km2 - area2019Km2) / area2017Km2) * 100; console.log(`2017 Area: ${area2017Km2.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${pixels2017})`); console.log(`2019 Area: ${area2019Km2.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${pixels2019})`); console.log(`Change: ${shrinkage.toFixed(1)}%`); // Consider shrinkage > 5% as significant if (shrinkage > 5) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
